body:
Completed bounded source-only follow-up cd101ed1-e8a0-4973-91ee-fd4916ebb4b4 on existing origin/codex/smart-preview-ui c22c4c49, preserving c6d05aa3 and SaveAs3ca3e9c9. Tests-first f9bfa533/bf80fa22; production3a0f2cbf. All 13 SmartPreviewUITests methods UNRUN. Source inspection and git diff --check only.

Full asset status work stays off MainActor. Selection controller now lets one active validation drain, skips superseded queued selections, shares same-selection status with Develop opening, and drains selection reads before batch mutation. No per-cell native reads/polling/timers. Native returned batch state reused instead of redundant full validation. Save callbacks invalidate without triggering another hash/decode; explicit Check Status or selection/open/source change obtains status as needed. Stale opener cannot retarget current selection. Snapshot is only routing hint: native open MUST independently revalidate source/journal/writer admission and refuse unsafe pending-edit Original routes. No native error fallback. This is an explicit native integration gate, not authority granted by cached UI state.

Added visible Library-menu and offline/pending thumbnail/AX disclosure: Library thumbnails show last synchronized image and Smart Preview edits appear there only after Sync. No claim that offline thumbnails are current, no compression/speed promise. Current native status operation is uncancellable and still drains; no latency/performance claim. A must validate read counts/actual worker execution and post-Sync thumbnail refresh with native integration/GUI.

Handoff appended at tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/SMART-PREVIEW-SWIFT-HANDOFF.md on c22c4c49, and durable wp/B5-16 CODEX-TAKEOVER updated. Native API unchanged; no generated bindings or Rust changes. No builds/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart/writer changes. A owns compiler/GUI/main.
